task: Map an explicit positive request or an author-defined descriptive request to one of twelve finite shapes and optional attributes. This is not arbitrary 3D generation or ambient association evaluation.
strict_primary_json: The entire raw_text must be one JSON object, without fences, commentary, duplicate keys, or NaN/Infinity. Leading and trailing whitespace are allowed.
policy: Ordinary prose without a request is hold.
Negated or explicitly quoted requests and source code are hold.
Unknown object names without sufficient known descriptive evidence are hold, even when known color/count/motion words occur.
A descriptive world motion is not automatically a flow or pulse attribute; motion must be requested for the representation.
The count is the number of displayed bodies, not the number of wings, branches, petals, or other parts.
Metaphor expectations are author-defined finite-choice targets, not objective proof of complete language understanding.
